stem.en: A cricket chirps in a field at night. How does it make the sound?

text.en: It rubs its wings together, so they vibrate.
A stretched skin inside its body vibrates when it breathes.
Air in a hollow tube in its body vibrates, as in a bansuri.
Two vocal cords in its throat vibrate, as in your voice.

explanation.en: Crickets rub their wings together, and grasshoppers rub their legs against their wings. The rubbed body parts vibrate and make the sound.

hints.en: Some animals make sound by rubbing body parts together.
